neighbours.label: a word with a leading space right after an opening parenthesis or quote mark that is followed by a space: '( word', '" word'
fire: The orchestra played two pieces ( Mozart and Haydn ) before the interval.
Add the dry ingredients ( flour, salt and sugar ) to the bowl.
Her grandmother ( born in Lisbon ) spoke four languages.
The trail passes a small lake ( Lake Anna ) after two miles.
Critics called the film a " masterpiece of suspense" when it opened.
The museum is closed on Mondays ( holidays included ) all year.
